parentAndMePendingRows.title: Parent & Baby Yoga with Marti Foster
parentAndMePendingRows.description: Outdoor Parent & Baby yoga — caregiver practices while baby comes along. Feeding, diapering, and baby needs are welcome in class. Weekly, weather permitting. Strong Parent & Me test case (grown-up participates; baby is part of the session). Separate Sat 10–11am prenatal class is not Parent & Me.
parentAndMePendingRows.tips:
Weather permitting — check with Marti if rain is likely.
Bring a large blanket, yoga mat, long scarf, baby carrier, and water.
Limited to about 8 moms with babies — register ahead.
Register at martifosteryoga.com.

parentAndMePendingRows.title: Music Together — Fall Mixed Ages

parentAndMePendingRows.description: 10-week Fall 2026 caregiver + child music series (babies–preschool + grown-up). Starts Sep 9 / Sep 14 · 10-week series.
Open seats as of Aug 27: Mon 9:30, 10:30, 11:30; Wed 9:30, 10:30; Fri 11:30. Fri 9:30 & 10:30 waitlist.
Free demo visit available before enrolling.
Register at mt-mp.com.
